headline: As of 2026-11-02: 55,973,605 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 48 of 50 states, D+8.4 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 55,973,605 early/mail ballots cast so far across 48 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+8.4 by registration.
Most ballots cast: Texas (7,749,004), California (6,018,065), Florida (5,424,345).
